# mabinogi-003 — establishment log (2026-11-11)

Evans 1907 cols 19 l. 12 – 27 l. 8 (PDF pp. 42–46), every column read on the page image (zoom 4; spot crops at zoom 5–8).
Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate disagreements and for punctuation shape
(the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised letters into the line (col 23 "gynte^d");
line-end marks and Evans's accents (col 20 "arglwydés") dropped.

## Other spots found on the images
- col 19 l. 21 — the witness's "[o Pwyll]" (Williams's supplement) is not in the White Book and the sense does not need it: not supplied.
- col 20 l. 36 / col 21 l. 1 — Evans "tormyn-|nawc" (line-end mark): one word **"tormynnawc"**; the witness's "tormyn nawc" is wrong.
- col 23 l. 8 — Evans prints **"ymdanw"** (no a); the witness supplies [a], the Red Book has "ymdanaw". Kept as written: a slip or contraction for *ymdanaw*. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 23 l. 5 — "Penn Annwn" (Evans "ann6n"; the pilot's Annwuyn is spelt differently here).
- col 26 l. 11 — "yd eistedwys paub y nos." — the witness's "[honno]" is not supplied.
- col 26 l. 17 — "digri-|uwch" across the line: "digriuwch".

## Word division and punctuation (ours, following the pilot's practice)
- Proclitics separated where the witness runs them together: "attep y uelly", "ac y uelly guare", "dy hun y mywn" (Evans spaces all three).
- "ry dodet" divided both times (Evans "rydodet"; the witness divides only the second).
- "e hun" as the witness (Evans "ehun").
- Speech nested inside speech (Rhiannon's instructions, Pwyll's answer to Gwawl): ‘ ’ inside “ ”, and “ ” again for the third level ("Digawn ry dodet ymman").
- The witness's broken quotation at "Llyna dy gynghor di," heb Riannon yna. Yd wyt …" repaired: Rhiannon's speech continues after the tag.
- Paragraphs: 10 (the parting and the feast at Hefeydd's; the suitor's request; Rhiannon's plan; Gwawl claims his answer; the year after and the bag; badger-in-the-bag; the terms; the wedding night; the next morning).
